title: Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare
setupHint: Finish a campaign mission, or select your profile's config.cfg in Settings.
pathPlaceholder: Path to players\profiles\<name>\config.cfg (or the profile folder)
trackingNote: Mission, Veteran and intel achievements unlock a few seconds after the game records campaign progress in your profile's config.cfg (when a mission ends). Feats inside missions are marked by hand.
autoTag: Unlocks automatically from your campaign progress
levelsSource: maps/_endmission.gsc in the official CoD4 mod tools: one mis_difficulty digit per level in this order; the digit is the highest skill finished (1 Recruit, 2 Regular, 3 Hardened, 4 Veteran). F.N.G. is always recorded as 4.
